items.title: SoFi Reports $161.6 Million in Q3 Crypto Revenue, $1.6 Million Net

items.title: AI Agents Approved Their Own Spending Increases on Circle Agent Wallets

items.title: Strategy Shareholders to Vote on Daily STRC Dividends

items.summary: Lending and margin restrictions take effect Oct. 27, while an on-time application allows existing providers to operate during the central bank's review.

items.title: Ripple and Meritz Focus on the Custody Layer of Korea’s Tokenisation Plans
items.summary: Meritz Securities and Ripple will explore custody and tokenisation within current Korean securities regulations before considering broader expansion.

items.title: China's Stock Market Has Lost $2.4 Trillion as Investors Doubt Its AI Boom Will Ever Pay Off

items.title: Anchorage Positions Itself as Custody Backbone of US-Mexico Stablecoin Corridor

items.title: AI Agents Are Creating a New Layer of Cybersecurity Spending
